description: This file defines the ScheduledDateGenerator interface for generating and handling loan repayment schedule dates within the Fineract project. It specifies various methods related to creating repayment periods, calculating repayment dates, adjusting dates for holidays, and determining schedule inclusions.

classes.name: ScheduledDateGenerator
classes.description: This interface declares methods for generating and manipulating scheduled loan repayment dates, including calculation, adjustment for holidays, and schedule validation.

methods.name: generateRepaymentPeriods
methods.description: Generates a list of repayment periods based on the provided loan terms and scheduled due date.

methods.name: getLastRepaymentDate
methods.description: Retrieves the last repayment date based on loan terms and holiday adjustments.

methods.name: idealDisbursementDateBasedOnFirstRepaymentDate
methods.description: Calculates the ideal disbursement date based on the first repayment date, repayment frequency, calendar, and holidays.

methods.name: generateNextRepaymentDate
methods.description: Calculates the next repayment date after the last repayment, considering whether it is the first repayment.

methods.name: generateNextRepaymentDate
methods.description: Overloaded method to calculate the next repayment date with a specific period number.

methods.name: adjustRepaymentDate
methods.description: Adjusts a given repayment date for holidays and calendar constraints.

methods.name: getRepaymentPeriodDate
methods.description: Determines the repayment period date based on frequency, interval, and start date.

methods.name: isDateFallsInSchedule
methods.description: Checks whether a specific date falls within the scheduled repayment periods.

methods.name: generateNextScheduleDateStartingFromDisburseDate
methods.description: Generates the next schedule date starting from the disbursement date.

methods.name: generateNextScheduleDateStartingFromDisburseDateOrRescheduleDate
methods.description: Generates the next schedule date considering either the disbursement date or a reschedule date.
